summary: Bladex filed a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, a routine foreign private issuer disclosure. The meeting covered standard agenda items: election of three directors, approval of audited financial statements, reappointment of KPMG as auditor, an advisory vote on executive compensation, and a name change from Banco Latinoamericano de Comercio Exterior, S.A. to Bladex, Inc. All proposals passed with strong majorities. Quorum was 68.10% of outstanding shares. This is an ordinary annual meeting update, not a special situation event.
